title: Ashish Kacholia portfolio: Ace investor adds 3 new stocks, trims stake in 13 companies in Q2

The changes include new bets on ESDS Software Solutions, Ardee Industries and Credent Connect N Care, while Fineotex Chemicals and Brand Concepts may have been exited.

title: Global Market: China's yuan hits more than four-year high against dollar
description: In a remarkable turn of events, China's yuan has surged against the US dollar, hitting levels unseen in over four years. This strength is linked to a declining dollar and prevailing central bank strategies. Although the People's Bank of China set a midpoint lower than anticipated, its actions aim to moderate currency appreciation. Analysts believe the yuan's resilience may hinge on sustained export performance and domestic demand influences.

title: Lam Research Stock: Why did LRCX shares fall despite record profits?

title: IGI shares hit 10% upper circuit as Q2 profit jumps 43%, revenue rises 31% YoY

title: Indian bonds steady after RBI minutes signal more rate hikes
description: Indian bond yields remain steady at approximately 7.45%, influenced by growing inflation anxieties. The Reserve Bank of India recently increased the repo rate to 5.50%, hinting that further hikes may follow. With climbing oil prices and food inflation heightening economic concerns, analysts speculate another increase may occur in December, before a potential pause. The elevated energy costs pose significant challenges for India's economy, affecting the rupee and government finances.
